environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK action, (3) A custom rule with ByteMatchStatement inspecting SingleQueryArgument 'department' for transformations URL_DECODE and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE followed by RegexPatternSet match against pattern '(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|(?:and|or)[\s/\*]+\d+[\s/\*]*=[\s/\*]*\d+|extractvalue|updatexml|load_file|into[\s]+(?:out|dump)file|benchmark\s*\()' with BLOCK action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch logging enabled for WAF with sampled requests visible in console.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.waf_rule_1: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet (priority 1, SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING overridden to COUNT, all others default BLOCK)
config.waf_rule_3: Custom RegexPatternSet rule on SingleQueryArgument 'department' with URL_DECODE+HTML_ENTITY_DECODE text transformations, pattern: '(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|(?:and|or)[\s/\*]+\d+[\s/\*]*=[\s/\*]*\d+|extractvalue|updatexml|load_file|into[\s]+(?:out|dump)file|benchmark\s*\()', action BLOCK (priority 3)
config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with no additional permissions
config.network: ALB security group allows 443 from 0.0.0.0/0, task SG allows 8080 only from ALB SG
